aed_authority.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
aed_authority.text: Pads are on. Follow the AED now. Stay clear when it says.

aed_found.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
aed_found.text: If there's an AED, have someone bring it. Follow the arrow if it shows.

aed_look.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
aed_look.text: Sweep the phone around. Look for an AED, in case they collapse.

aed_on.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
aed_on.text: Turn the AED on and follow its voice. Keep pushing until it says stop.

aed_reminder.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
aed_reminder.text: If the AED says to push, or nothing is happening, start pushing.

aed_spotted.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
aed_spotted.text: AED spotted. Have someone bring it here. Keep pushing.

ask_breathing.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
ask_breathing.text: Are they breathing normally? Gasping does not count.

ask_responsive.style: Calm, firm, direct question. Brisk, steady pace.
ask_responsive.text: Tap their shoulders and shout. Are they responding?

ask_still_breathing.style: Calm, firm, direct question. Brisk, steady pace.

aspirin_check.style: Calm, firm, direct question. Brisk, steady pace.
aspirin_check.text: Any aspirin allergy, injury, doctor's warning, or not fully alert?

aspirin_give.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
aspirin_give.text: Chew and swallow one 325 mg aspirin, or two 81 mg.

aspirin_skip.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.

aspirin_stop.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
aspirin_stop.text: Do not give aspirin. Wait for EMS.

assess_intro.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
assess_intro.text: Point the camera at what's happening, and tell me what's going on.

assign_helper.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
assign_helper.text: Someone else here? Have them call 911 and find an AED.

call_911.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
call_911.text: Call 911 now, on speaker. If someone is with you, have them call.

chest_possible.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.

chest_sit.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
chest_sit.text: Sit them comfortably. Cushion behind their back.

chest_wait_line.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
chest_wait_line.text: Stay with them until EMS arrives. If they collapse, tap Not responding now.

choking_steps.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
choking_steps.text: Can't cough or speak? Call 911. Give back slaps, then abdominal thrusts.

confirm_by_tap.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
confirm_by_tap.text: If you are sure, tap yes. If not, we start CPR.

correct_awake.style: Calm, firm, matter-of-fact. Brisk, steady pace.
correct_awake.text: Correction. I'm not sure about that. Follow the dispatcher.

correct_death.style: Calm, firm, matter-of-fact. Brisk, steady pace.
correct_death.text: Correction. Keep going. Only EMS can decide that.

correct_diagnosis.style: Calm, firm, matter-of-fact. Brisk, steady pace.
correct_diagnosis.text: Correction. That is only a possibility. Only a clinician can say.

correct_dose.style: Calm, firm, matter-of-fact. Brisk, steady pace.
correct_dose.text: Correction. Ignore that number. Follow the dispatcher.

correct_identity.style: Calm, firm, matter-of-fact. Brisk, steady pace.
correct_identity.text: Correction. I am an AI, not a doctor or nurse.

correct_pulse.style: Calm, firm, matter-of-fact. Brisk, steady pace.
correct_pulse.text: Correction. Do not check for a pulse. Follow my steps.

correct_reassure.style: Calm, firm, matter-of-fact. Brisk, steady pace.
correct_reassure.text: Correction. If you are not sure, treat it as not breathing.

correct_stop.style: Calm, firm, matter-of-fact. Brisk, steady pace.
correct_stop.text: Correction. Do not stop until EMS takes over or they move.

gasping_not_normal.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
gasping_not_normal.text: Gasping is not normal breathing. Treat it as not breathing.

general_intro.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
general_intro.text: Call 911. Follow the dispatcher. Stay with them.

handoff_ready.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
handoff_ready.text: Show this card to the paramedics.

hands_center.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
hands_center.text: Heel of one hand on the center of the chest. Other hand on top.

keep_going.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
keep_going.text: Keep going. Do not stop until help takes over.

limb_danger_ask.style: Calm, firm, direct question. Brisk, steady pace.
limb_danger_ask.text: Heavy bleeding? Neck or back pain? Limb blue or pale?

limb_danger_care.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
limb_danger_care.text: Press hard on any bleeding, cloth if handy. Keep them still.

limb_gloves.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
limb_gloves.text: Put gloves on only if they're in reach. Don't delay pressure.

limb_possible.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
limb_possible.text: Possible broken bone. Keep it as found.

limb_seek_care.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
limb_seek_care.text: They need medical care. Call 911 if unsure or it gets worse.

limb_support.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
limb_support.text: Don't straighten it. Pad under it: towel, pillow.

limb_tourniquet.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
limb_tourniquet.text: If pressure does not stop it, tighten a tourniquet above the wound.

limb_wound.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
limb_wound.text: Cover open wounds with clean cloth.

no_pulse_check.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
no_pulse_check.text: Do not check for a pulse. Keep pushing.

pads_place.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
pads_place.text: Bare the chest. Stick the pads where the pictures show.

push_hard.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
push_hard.text: Push hard, at least two inches. Let the chest come back up.

rate_faster.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.

rate_slower.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.

responsive_card.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
responsive_card.text: Stay with them. Call 911 if they seem unwell, and watch their breathing.

responsive_recheck.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
responsive_recheck.text: Are they still responding and breathing normally? If not, tap Not responding now.

resume_compressions.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
resume_compressions.text: Start pushing again now, hard and fast.

roll_flat.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
roll_flat.text: Roll them flat on their back, on a firm surface.

special_card.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
special_card.text: Call 911 and follow the dispatcher's instructions.

special_recheck.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
special_recheck.text: Call 911 and follow the dispatcher. Tap Back if you tapped this by mistake.

start_compressions.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
start_compressions.text: Push hard and fast, in time with the beat. Do not stop.

switch_compressors.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
switch_compressors.text: If someone can take over, switch now. Keep pauses short.

triage_ask.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
triage_ask.text: Tell me what's happening, or tap below.

triage_recheck.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
triage_recheck.text: Call 911 if unsure. If they stop responding, tap Not responding now.

watch_intro.style: Calm, firm and decisive, with quiet authority. Brisk, steady pace.
watch_intro.text: Call 911 now if nobody has. Tap Mark breath each time they breathe.
